subject: The 3AM feature you haven't touched
preview_text: Most users skip this, but it's the one thing that stops the spiral cold.
body_paragraphs: Remember that 3AM moment last night—lying awake, phone in hand, fighting the urge to text them? I've been there. It's the worst part of healing, and it's the reason I built something you haven't tried yet.

Almost everyone skips this when they first download the app. They stick to the journal or the mood tracker, thinking those are enough. But the real game-changer is the feature that catches you at your lowest—when your brain is replaying memories and your fingers are twitching toward their name.

Open Fresh Start and look for the Emergency Mode button. It's designed specifically for those middle-of-the-night spirals. One tap, and you get a guided exercise that pulls you out of the panic and back into your own body. No willpower required—just a second of courage to tap it.

Try it now, even if you're not in crisis. Just open the app and see how it works. The next time 3AM hits, you'll know exactly where to go. P.S. Users who use Emergency Mode once are 70% less likely to break no-contact that night. Don't skip this.
